entryPointCandidates.name: Program.cs
entryPointCandidates.summary: ASP.NET Core API entry point and composition root: registers controllers with the global ValidationFilter, Application and Infrastructure services, JWT bearer auth (reading tokens from the cortex_access_token cookie), CORS for the frontend, and OpenAPI/Scalar in development.

entryPointCandidates.name: DependencyInjection.cs
entryPointCandidates.summary: Infrastructure composition extension that registers the Npgsql EF Core DbContext, binds settings sections, maps Application interfaces to repository/auth/email implementations, and configures the Brevo HttpClient.

entryPointCandidates.name: AuthRequestValidators.cs
entryPointCandidates.summary: FluentValidation validators for every auth request DTO, enforcing required fields, email format and length limits (e.g. password 8-128 characters) before requests reach AuthService.

entryPointCandidates.name: ValidationFilter.cs
entryPointCandidates.summary: Global MVC action filter that resolves FluentValidation validators for each action argument and short-circuits with a 400 ValidationProblemDetails response on failures.

entryPointCandidates.name: AGENTS.md
entryPointCandidates.summary: Authoritative project charter for contributors and AI coding agents describing Cortex as a multi-tenant AI support and conversational commerce SaaS, its core features (assistants, RAG, catalogs, widget, billing), intended tech stack, Clean Architecture layering, and mandatory rules such as no MediatR, strict tenant isolation and no unrequested implementation.

documentation.name: AGENTS.md
documentation.summary: Authoritative project charter for contributors and AI coding agents describing Cortex as a multi-tenant AI support and conversational commerce SaaS, its core features (assistants, RAG, catalogs, widget, billing), intended tech stack, Clean Architecture layering, and mandatory rules such as no MediatR, strict tenant isolation and no unrequested implementation.

documentation.name: FRONTEND_INTEGRATION.md
documentation.summary: Developer guide for running the backend locally with Docker Compose and an external PostgreSQL instance, applying EF Core migrations, and integrating the NextAuth frontend via the Google ID-token exchange at /api/auth/google-session, HttpOnly auth cookies, CORS with credentials, and the other auth endpoints.

infrastructure.name: .dockerignore
infrastructure.summary: Docker build-context exclusion list that keeps bin/obj build output, IDE folders, the git directory, the real .env secrets file and local appsettings overrides out of the API image.

infrastructure.name: Dockerfile
infrastructure.summary: Multi-stage Docker build that restores and publishes the Cortex.Api project with the .NET 10 SDK, then runs Cortex.Api.dll on the ASP.NET 10 runtime image exposing port 8080.

infrastructure.name: build
infrastructure.summary: Build stage based on the .NET 10 SDK image that restores Cortex.Api dependencies and publishes a Release build to /app/publish.

infrastructure.name: runtime
infrastructure.summary: Runtime stage based on the ASP.NET 10 image that copies the published output, exposes port 8080 and starts Cortex.Api.dll.

infrastructure.name: docker-compose.yml
infrastructure.summary: Docker Compose definition for local development that builds the API from the Dockerfile, injects database, JWT, Google OAuth, frontend URL and Brevo settings from .env (failing fast when required ones are missing), and maps host port 5203 to container port 8080.

infrastructure.name: api
infrastructure.summary: The single compose service running the Cortex ASP.NET Core API in Development mode; PostgreSQL is intentionally not included and must be provided by each developer.

data.name: POST /api/auth/register
data.summary: POST /api/auth/register action delegating to AuthService.RegisterAsync and returning the new user with a verify-your-email message. Public (anonymous) endpoint.

data.name: POST /api/auth/login
data.summary: POST /api/auth/login action that calls AuthService.LoginAsync and sets token cookies on success. Public (anonymous) endpoint.

data.name: POST /api/auth/google-session
data.summary: POST /api/auth/google-session action exchanging a Google ID token via AuthService.GoogleSessionAsync and setting token cookies. Public (anonymous) endpoint.

data.name: GET /api/auth/verify-email
data.summary: GET /api/auth/verify-email action verifying the query token via AuthService.VerifyEmailAsync and signing the user in. Public (anonymous) endpoint.

data.name: POST /api/auth/resend-verification
data.summary: POST /api/auth/resend-verification action calling AuthService.ResendVerificationAsync and always returning a neutral message. Public (anonymous) endpoint.

data.name: POST /api/auth/refresh
data.summary: POST /api/auth/refresh action rotating tokens via AuthService.RefreshAsync and resetting cookies. Public (anonymous) endpoint.

data.name: POST /api/auth/logout
data.summary: Authorized POST /api/auth/logout action that deletes the access and refresh token cookies. Requires authorization.

data.name: GET /api/auth/me
data.summary: Authorized GET /api/auth/me action that parses the JWT sub claim and returns the current user via AuthService.GetCurrentUserAsync. Requires authorization.

data.name: organizations
data.summary: Tenant table for business organizations, with a unique slug index.

data.name: users
data.summary: Business-owner user table with a unique email index; parent of memberships, external accounts and verification tokens.

data.name: organization_memberships
data.summary: Join table linking users to organizations, unique per organization/user pair and cascading on delete.

data.name: user_accounts
data.summary: Login accounts per user (credential or external provider), unique on provider and provider account ID.

data.name: email_verification_tokens
data.summary: Stores hashed, expiring email verification tokens for users, unique on token hash.

config.name: .env.example
config.summary: Template for the local .env file consumed by Docker Compose, listing required settings for the database connection string, JWT secret/issuer/audience, Google OAuth client ID, Brevo API key and sender identity, and the frontend base URL (placeholder values only).

config.name: Cortex.Api.csproj
config.summary: Web SDK project file for the API layer targeting net10.0 with nullable and implicit usings, referencing OpenAPI, Scalar API docs and EF Core packages plus the Application and Infrastructure projects as the composition root.

config.name: appsettings.Development.json
config.summary: Development-environment overrides for the API that set default and ASP.NET Core log levels.

config.name: appsettings.json
config.summary: Base API configuration defining log levels and allowed hosts; JWT, database and Brevo settings are supplied via environment variables or user secrets instead.

config.name: launchSettings.json
config.summary: Local launch profiles running the API in the Development environment over HTTP on port 5203 and HTTPS on port 7187, without auto-launching a browser.

config.name: Cortex.Application.csproj
config.summary: Project file for the Application layer targeting net10.0, referencing only the Domain project plus FluentValidation and DI abstractions, consistent with Clean Architecture dependency rules.

config.name: Cortex.Domain.csproj
config.summary: Minimal project file for the Domain layer targeting net10.0 with no project or package references, keeping the core model framework-independent.

config.name: Cortex.Infrastructure.csproj
config.summary: Project file for the Infrastructure layer referencing Application and Domain, and pulling in EF Core with the Npgsql PostgreSQL provider and design tools, BCrypt hashing, Google ID-token validation, JWT bearer/token libraries and user secrets.

list.name: API Layer
list.description: ASP.NET Core presentation and composition root: the thin AuthController and its /api/auth endpoints, Program.cs DI/JWT/Scalar wiring, the FluentValidation action filter, and the HTTP request scratch file.

list.name: Application Layer
list.description: Authentication use cases (AuthService), request/response DTOs, FluentValidation validators, the Result/error model, and the repository, token, hashing, email, and identity-validation interfaces that Infrastructure implements.

list.name: Domain Layer
list.description: Framework-free core model of tenants and identities: User, UserAccount, Organization, OrganizationMembership, EmailVerificationToken entities and the OrganizationRole enum.

list.name: Persistence Layer
list.description: EF Core data access for PostgreSQL: CortexDbContext and design-time factory, Fluent entity configurations, repository and unit-of-work implementations, and migrations defining the users, organizations, memberships, accounts, and verification token tables.

list.name: External Integrations
list.description: Infrastructure adapters for authentication concerns: JWT token issuance, BCrypt password hashing, Google ID token validation, Brevo email delivery, their typed settings, and the Infrastructure DI registration.

list.name: Configuration & Build
list.description: Solution and project files for the four Clean Architecture projects, appsettings and launch profiles for the API, and the environment variable template.

list.name: Deployment
list.description: Container packaging and orchestration: the multi-stage Dockerfile (build and runtime stages), docker-compose API service, and Docker ignore rules.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: Project specification and agent rules (AGENTS.md) plus the frontend integration guide describing how the Next.js client consumes the auth API.
